urdu transliteration: Naame Abbas Wasila hai Har Dua ke liye
english translation text: The name of Abbas is the wasila for every prayer.

urdu transliteration: Isme aazam hai ye momin ke iltijaa ke liye
english translation text: It is the Greatest Name for the supplication of every believer.

urdu transliteration: Naame Abbas Wasila Hair Dua ke liye
english translation text: The name of Abbas is the wasila for every prayer.

urdu transliteration:
Koi mane ya namaane hai ye imaan mera
Naame Abbas to bakhshish ka hai saamaan mera
Chashma e faiz hai (x2) Ye darr har ek gada ke liye
english translation text:
Whether people accept it or not, this is my belief.
The name of Abbas is the provision of my salvation.
It is a fountain of grace, for every beggar who comes to this door.

urdu transliteration: Naame Abbas Wasila Hair Dua ke liye
english translation text: The name of Abbas is the means for every prayer.

urdu transliteration:
Deed karta hoon alam par to qalam rukta hai
Yaad ajaate hai ghazi mujhe yoon lagta hai
Abhi rota hai (x2) ye zainab teri ridaa ke liye
english translation text:
Whenever I gaze upon the alam, my pen falls silent.
The memory of Ghazi Abbas comes rushing back to me.
Even now Zainab still weeps, for the sake of your veil.

urdu transliteration: Naame Abbas Wasila Hair Dua ke liye
english translation text: The name of Abbas is the means for every prayer.

urdu transliteration:
Hum ko roze pe bulawo. Meray akaa Abbas. Chumalay aak-e zari ko. Mera akaa Abbas. 
Behra Masum-e sakina (x2) ki iltijaa ke liye.
english translation text:
Call us to your shrine, my master Abbas.
Let me kiss the sacred grille, my master Abbas.
For the plea of innocent Sakina

urdu transliteration: Naam-e abbas-e wasila. Hay har duwa ke liye.
english translation text:
The name of Abbas is the means for every prayer.
It is the means for every supplication.
